stepExplanation: When equilibrium shifts left, [NH3] decreases while [N2] and [H2] increase. Since Kc = [NH3]^2/([N2][H2]^3), the numerator decreases and denominator increases, so Kc decreases.
stepBody: What happens to the value of Kc when temperature is increased for this exothermic reaction? (Answer: increases, decreases, or stays the same)
